OPEN-SOURCE AI MEMORY INFRASTRUCTURE

AI memory, with its evidence attached.

MESA is open-source memory infrastructure for AI systems. It keeps information connected to its sources, relationships, and authorized data scope.

Explore documentationView on GitHub

THE PROBLEM

A relevant passage is only the beginning.

An assistant finds an opening time in an old document. Which revision supports it? Does the current session have access? Has the replacement revision finished processing?

MESA puts source identity, authorized scope and processing state in the memory contract, so applications can inspect the basis of a result.

CORE CAPABILITIES

Memory you can inspect and operate.

Source provenance

Trace a returned assertion through its document, immutable revision, chunk and supporting evidence.

Scope before ranking

Server-created sessions freeze authorized datasets. Tenant eligibility is resolved before a lane contributes.

Observable lifecycle

Follow admission, projection and terminal mutation state. A 202 response means work was admitted.

GET STARTED · v0.8.0

Start locally. Keep the version explicit.

git clone --branch v0.8.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA.git
cd MESA
uv sync --locked --extra dev

Continue with the model-disabled V3 quickstart for a local first run. Canonical V4 writes require provisioned extraction and embedding providers.
